title: Porch Group Announces Attendance at Upcoming Investor Events
summary: Porch Group, Inc. (“Porch”) (Nasdaq: PRCH), a new kind of homeowners insurance company, today announced its upcoming investor event attendance. Porch Management will be attending and participating in one-on-one and group investor meetings at these upcoming events: August 12, 2026: 29 th Annual Technology, Internet Communications Conference (Virtual) August 13, 2026: 8 th Annual Needham FinTech Digital Transformation Conference (Virtual) August 18-19, 2026: Craig Hallum Non-Deal Roadshow (San Francisco, Denver) August 21, 2026: Three Part Advisors Investor Meeting (Virtual) September 1, 2026: Stephens Inc. Non-Deal Roadshow (Boston) September 9, 2026: KBW Insurance Conference (New York City) September 10, 2026: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference (San Francisco) September 17, 2026: StoneX 13 th Annual Tech, Media Telecom Conference (New York City) September 22-23, 2026: Oppenheimer Non-Deal Roadshow (Toronto/Montreal) September 24, 2026: Cantor Non-Deal
